ITEM 1 | Dense cluster of bright green floret-type pieces with tree-like branching tops and short pale stems, arranged in the upper right of the plate; firm, moist-looking surface with fine bumpy texture, some florets about 2-3 cm across, no visible browning or char | 95
ITEM 2 | Dark green leafy greens with flat, lobed, wavy-edged leaves and thin pale stems, spread across the right and lower-center of the plate; slightly glossy, some leaves folded, no dressing sheen visible, roughly 15-18 cm across footprint | 60
ITEM 3 | Small pile of tan-brown granular pieces, roughly round and lentil-like, about 0.3-0.5 cm each, clustered in the lower-left area; glossy and slightly sticky-looking with brown glaze coating, some pieces with darker reddish-brown bits mixed in, moist and clumped rather than flowing | 45
ITEM 4 | Thin amber-brown liquid sheen and glaze pooled around the tan granular pile and along the lower-left edge of the greens, glossy and slightly viscous, with small darker bits suspended in it | 8
ITEM 5 | Scattered small pale-green and tan fragments, a few tiny bits of leaf or herb near the upper-left of the greens and along the edge of the broccoli cluster, each under 0.5 cm | 2
